chapter.verse: Tua nungah kum sawmleli khit ciangin Barnabas tawh Jerusalem ka paito leuleu uh a, Titus zong ka tonpih uh hi.

Mangmuhna khat hangin a va paito ka hi a, tu laitaka ka septe leh ka sepsate a mawkna a suah loh nading cihna tawh Gentile mite' tunga ka tangkokhiat Lungdamna Thu mah (a zahtak-huai mite tawh aituam kimuhna ciang bek ahih sam hangin) amaute' mai-ah ka luui hi.
Himah taleh kei tawh a kithuah Titus pen Greek mi ahih hangin vun-at dingin kithatang sawl lo hi.
Hinapi, sanggam kineihkhemte in ei teng hong silabawl nuamin Khris Jesu' sunga i ngah suahtakna thu a kan dingin hong lutsim uh a, tua huhau-in thubuai hong om hi.
Ahih hangin mitphiat kikal sung nangawn tua mite' nuai ka niamlut vet kei uh a, tua pen note' sungah thumaan thutak Lungdamna Thu a kipsuak theih nading ahi hi.

Tua hi a, huzap khauh nei a kicite (milian ahih ngei uh hangin kei' ading kilamdanna om lo; Pasian in maipha piaktuam nei lo ahih manin)—tua huzap khauh nei a kici mite in kei' tungah behlap bangmah hong nei lo uh hi.

Tua sangsikin vun-at mite' tungah Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiat ding vaipuak Peter a ki-ap mah bangin vun-atloh mite' tungah Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiat ding vaipuak kei hong ki-ap ahihlam amaute in a theih uh ciangin
(vun-at mite' kiangah sawltak nasep a sem dingin Peter a zang Pasian in Gentile mite' kiangah a sem dingin kei hong zang ahihlam a theih uh ciangin), leh

phungpi teng ahi James, Cephas, leh John -te in keima' ngah hehpihna a muhkhak uh ciangin Barnabas leh kei pen Gentile mite' kiangah, leh amau pen vun-at mite' kiangah, a pai tek dingin kikholhkhopna taklam khut hong khak uh hi.
Mizawngte phawk ding cih thu bek hong kal uh a, tua lah ka hihnop thu pen mah hi pah hi.
Ahi zongin Antioch ah Cephas hong tun ciangin mawhsak nading om ahih manin a maitang mah ah ka dongkhak hi.
A hang pen James' kiangpan mi kimkhat hong tun ma-in Cephas in Gentile mite tawh an nekhawm napi tua mite hong tun ciangin vun-atte pawl a kihtakna hangin tonkikin kidaithah hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mi a omlai teng in zong puatham kineihna lam pawm uh a, tua huhau-in Barnabas nangawn amau' puatham kineihna lamah hoi tanghial hi.

Amaute, thumaan thutak Lungdamna Thu tawh kituakin tangtak kalsuan lo cih ka muh ciangin vekpi' mai-ah Cephas ka hopih a, “Nang Jew mi khat hinapi, Jew mi bang hilo-in Gentile mi bangin gamta na hihleh bang hangin Jew mite bangin a gamta dingin Gentile mite thatang sawl thei na hi hiam?” ka ci hi.
Kote pen pianngeizia thu ah Jew mi ka hi uh a, Gentile mawhneite ka hikei uh hi.

Himah taleh mihing' ngah diksakna thu pen thukhun zuihna hang hilo-in Jesu Khris ii ciamkipna hang ahihlam thei ka hih manun kote in zong thukhun zuihna hang ahilo, Khris ii ciamkipna tawh diksakna ka ngah nadingun Khris Jesu ka um uh hi. A hang pen thukhun zuihna tawh kuamah in diksakna ngah lo ding ahih man hi.
Ahi zongin Khris sungah diksakna ngah nading ka hanciam laitak mahun mawhnei ka hihlam uh hong kilang ahihleh Khris pen mawhna lama nasem khat ahi ding hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi!
Ka phelsa khat a lamkik ka hihleh thukhun palsat ka hihna a lakcian ka hi hi.
A hang pen thukhun huhau-in thukhun tawh kisai thu ah ka si a, tua pen Pasian' kiangah ka nuntak theih nading ahi hi. Kei pen Khris tawh hong kikhailumkhawm khin hi.
Tu-in kei a nungta hi nawnlo-in kei' sungah Khris a nungta hizaw hi. Tu-a cilesa tawh ka nuntak pen kei hong itin kei' ading amahmah hong kipiatawm Pasian' Tapa ii ciamkipna tawh a nungta ka hi hi.
Hih bang ka cih ciangin Pasian' hehpihna a pampaih ka hikei a, thukhun zuihna hangin diksakna kingah hileh Khris a sih pen khiatna nei lo pi hiding a ci nuam ka hizaw hi.
